about: One button per brand. 'match' is compared, lower-cased, with ro.product.brand and ro.product.manufacturer. 'lists' are files in data/lists, applied in order. Menu names in the steps differ a little between OS versions; they were written against the versions sold in 2025-2026.

brands.name: Xiaomi
devOptions: Open Settings › About phone.
Tap OS version (HyperOS) or MIUI version 7 times, until it says you are a developer.
Go to Settings › Additional settings › Developer options.
Turn on USB debugging. If a change later fails with a permission error, also turn on USB debugging (Security settings); Xiaomi asks for a SIM card and a Mi account for that one.

settings.title: Lock-screen stories
steps: Settings › Lock screen › Wallpaper Carousel (or Glance), turn it off.

settings.title: Personalised ads
steps: Settings › Passwords & security › Privacy › Ad services, turn off Personalised ad recommendations.

settings.title: Ads inside Xiaomi apps
steps: In File Manager, Security, Cleaner, Downloads, Music, Themes and GetApps: open the app's settings and turn off Receive recommendations (sometimes under About or More settings).

settings.title: App Vault
steps: Pinch the home screen › Settings (or More) › turn off App Vault.

brands.name: Samsung
devOptions: Open Settings › About phone › Software information.
Tap Build number 7 times and enter your PIN.
Go back to Settings › Developer options (at the bottom).
Turn on USB debugging.

settings.title: Lock-screen stories (Glance)
steps: Settings › Lock screen › Wallpaper services, choose None.

settings.title: Samsung Free
steps: Pinch the home screen, swipe to the leftmost page and turn Samsung Free off.

settings.title: Customisation Service
steps: Settings › Privacy › Customisation Service (or Samsung account › Privacy), turn off customised content and ads.

settings.title: Marketing notifications
steps: Galaxy Store › Menu › Settings, turn off marketing notifications. Do the same in Samsung Members and Samsung Health if you use them.

brands.name: realme
devOptions: Open Settings › About device › Version.
Tap Build number 7 times and enter your PIN.
Go to Settings › Additional settings › Developer options.
Turn on USB debugging.

settings.title: Lock-screen stories (Glance)
steps: Settings › Lock screen › Glance for realme (or Lock Screen Magazine), turn it off.

settings.title: Recommendations
steps: Settings › Additional settings › System services (or Privacy) › turn off Get recommendations / Personalised recommendations.

settings.title: Hot Apps folders
steps: Open the Hot Apps or Hot Games folder, open its settings and turn off app recommendations, then remove the folder.

settings.title: App Market and browser pushes
steps: Long-press the notification › turn off notifications for App Market and Browser.

brands.name: OPPO
devOptions: Open Settings › About device › Version.
Tap Build number 7 times and enter your PIN.
Go to Settings › Additional settings (System settings on newer phones) › Developer options.
Turn on USB debugging.

settings.title: Lock Screen Magazine
steps: Settings › Wallpapers & style (or Lock screen) › Lock Screen Magazine, turn it off.

settings.title: Recommendations
steps: Settings › Privacy › turn off Personalised recommendations; in App Market › Settings, turn off recommendations.

settings.title: Hot Apps folders
steps: Open the Hot Apps folder, open its settings and turn off recommendations, then remove the folder.

brands.name: vivo
devOptions: Open Settings › About phone › Software version.
Tap Software version 7 times.
Go to Settings › System management (or Additional settings) › Developer options.
Turn on USB debugging.

settings.title: Lock-screen posters
steps: Settings › Lock screen & wallpaper (or Wallpaper & style) › turn off the poster / magazine lock screen.

settings.title: App store and browser pushes
steps: Long-press the promo notification › turn off notifications for V-Appstore and Browser.

settings.title: Recommendations
steps: Settings › Security & privacy › Privacy › turn off Personalised recommendations where it is offered.

brands.name: Infinix
devOptions: Open Settings › About phone.
Tap Build number 7 times.
Go to Settings › System › Developer options.
Turn on USB debugging.

settings.title: Magazine lock screen
steps: Settings › Lock screen (or Wallpaper) › Magazine lock screen, turn it off.

settings.title: Promo notifications
steps: Long-press any promo notification › turn off notifications for Phone Master, Palm Store, AHA Games and the browser.

settings.title: Home-screen suggestions
steps: Long-press the home screen › Settings › turn off app suggestions or Hot Apps.

brands.name: Motorola
devOptions: Open Settings › About phone.
Tap Build number 7 times and enter your PIN.
Go to Settings › System › Developer options.
Turn on USB debugging.

settings.title: Lock-screen stories (Glance)
steps: Settings › Display (or Lock screen) › Glance, turn it off.

settings.title: Motorola promos
steps: Settings › Apps › Motorola Notifications › Notifications, turn them off.

brands.name: Honor
devOptions: Open Settings › About phone.
Tap Build number 7 times and enter your PIN.
Go to Settings › System & updates › Developer options.
Turn on USB debugging, and Allow ADB debugging in charge only mode if you see it.

settings.title: Magazine unlock
steps: Settings › Home screen & wallpaper › Magazine unlock, turn off the subscriptions or switch to a plain wallpaper.

settings.title: Folder suggestions
steps: Open any home-screen folder with a 'Recommended' row and switch it off in the folder.

settings.title: Personalised ads
steps: Settings › Privacy › Ads and privacy, turn off personalised ads.

brands.name: Huawei
devOptions: Open Settings › About phone.
Tap Build number 7 times and enter your PIN.
Go to Settings › System & updates › Developer options.
Turn on USB debugging, and Allow ADB debugging in charge only mode if you see it.

settings.title: Magazine unlock
steps: Settings › Home screen & wallpaper › Magazine unlock, turn off the subscriptions or switch to a plain wallpaper.

settings.title: Folder suggestions
steps: Open any home-screen folder with a 'Recommended' row and switch it off in the folder.

settings.title: Personalised ads
steps: Settings › Privacy › Ads and privacy, turn off personalised ads.

everyPhone.title: Advertising ID
steps: Settings › Google › Ads (or Settings › Privacy › Ads), tap Delete advertising ID.

everyPhone.title: Any app that sends promos
steps: Long-press the promo notification, tap the gear, and turn off that kind of notification.
